extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / editors (especially new users attempting to create a page)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating or troubleshooting a new English Wikipedia page (here, an attempted 'Will and Grace jokes' article), including account requirements, searching for existing content, title/redirect issues, and checking deletion or caching problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for 'Will and Grace jokes' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the search to avoid creating a duplicate article and to check for similar coverage under a different title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the title ('What links here')
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspect incoming links to find related content or appropriate locations to add material instead of creating a new page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization and create redirects where appropriate so users can find the topic under variant spellings/capitalizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent creation / database update delay
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes for the database to update or try the purge function to refresh the page view.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if the page is missing
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review deletion reasons and logs to understand whether deletion was for notability, policy violations, or other issues before attempting recreation.
